hero.title: BISC8
hero.text: Straight from Brasilia, DF, BISC8 (which means cookie in Portuguese) is a studio that charms wherever it goes, combining the right measure of fun and professionalism to create unique games that defy the obvious. After all, only Brazilians, students, players, and developers truly understand the meaning of BISC8. Now it's time to take this idea from Brazil to the world!
quem.label: Who Are We?
quem.title: THE SEARCH FOR SOMETHING DIFFERENT
narrative.p1: BISC8 was created in 2023, during Game Jams, driven by the desire to create surprising experiences.
narrative.p2: With the growth of the team and its members graduating in Digital Games, this goal gained strength and transformed into a studio.
narrative.p3: In 2026, we took the next step and became a company, without leaving behind what brought us here: curiosity and the courage to break from the obvious, the passion for creating, and the desire to develop games that make every player feel they found something special.
narrative.highlight: All this search to produce the different is what it means to be BISC8.

games.noon.detail: Noon reinvents hide-and-seek with an innovative mechanic based on light and shadows. Play as Fire, illuminating the scenario, burning objects and hunting creatures from the darkness, or take on the role of a Shadow, hiding among objects and blending into the dark to escape. In each match, controlling light means controlling survival.
games.bananabongo.detail: BananaBongo is a rhythm and memory game that puts your reflexes to the test in dance battles against a fun tribe of monkeys. Memorize step sequences, follow the rhythm of the music, and execute every move with precision to overcome increasingly intense challenges and discover the story behind each dancer.
games.overtime.detail: Overtime portrays the duality between surviving and pursuing your dreams. During the day, take on the role of Túlio, working in a restaurant, serving customers and enduring the demands of a relentless boss to make a living. At night, the kitchen transforms into a magical place where you can finally follow your true passion: cooking for ghosts, preparing their last orders before they find peace and move on to the afterlife.
games.pops.detail: Pops: On the Go is a warm and contemplative experience where you follow the routine of a popcorn seller while reflecting on his work, life, and feelings. Make popcorn by controlling the skillet and keeping the kernels heated until they pop, with no pressure, no defeat, and at your own pace. With a sensitive narrative, relaxing soundtrack, fully animated watercolor visuals, and full controller support, the game invites you to slow down and enjoy the simplicity of each moment.
games.trashexe.detail: Trash.exe transforms the simple task of freeing up computer space into a chaotic adventure. To install a new application, you'll need to delete files and programs that refuse to disappear without a fight. Face each application in intense battles, dodge a rain of attacks, eliminate everything occupying memory, and conquer the 4 units of space needed to complete the installation. But beware... maybe they don't want to be forgotten so easily.
games.lastplant.detail: In the vast emptiness of space, a robot, a teenager, and a child carry humanity's last hope: the only remaining plant in the universe. On a journey back to Earth, they must face alien creatures and civilizations that seek to take this precious resource at any cost. Build and strengthen your ship, gather resources, complete tasks, and defend your crew against constant attacks to ensure the last seed of life reaches its destination safely.
members.gomes.bio: A visual effects specialist who brings BISC8's games to life. Responsible for creating particles, lighting, and visual elements that enhance the player experience.
members.ismael.bio: A 3D modeler and animator responsible for creating characters, environments, and objects that come to life in BISC8's games. Turns concepts into detailed three-dimensional assets.
members.jaque.bio: A C# programmer specializing in Unity, responsible for game logic and gameplay mechanic implementation. Turns ideas into functional, optimized code.
members.natan.bio:
Founder of BISC8 and studio co-lead alongside Thor Cavalcanti. He is responsible for the brand, pitch development, and relationships with investors, sponsors, partners, and events.

He also works as a Sound Designer, Foley Artist, and composer, with three years of experience using FL Studio, 1BITDRAGON, FMOD, and audio implementation in Unity, as well as C# knowledge. He developed a Unity package that streamlines FMOD integration and speeds up the team's development process.

He is also a Concept Artist and Pixel Artist, with more than six years of experience in digital illustration using Adobe Photoshop and Krita.
members.natan.noon.subtitle: Screens/UI Concept
members.natan.noon.description: For Noon, Natan created a wide range of concepts that helped accelerate asset production, with a particular focus on the game's user interfaces. The art direction combines Tim Burton's gothic, cartoon-inspired imagery with references to Don't Starve Together, translated into dark, sketchy elements filled with movement. Despite its shadowy atmosphere, the UI remains welcoming, playful, and vibrant, capturing the excitement of a good old-fashioned game of hide-and-seek.
members.natan.project.subtitle: Cindy Cinidrius Concept
members.natan.project.description: Cindy Cinidrius is a gnome from the Undevil RPG universe, which inspires the fighting game currently in development. Far beyond her origins, Cindy is recognized as one of the greatest minds of her era. She played a leading role in revolutionizing the use of Krobian Crystals, driving advances that transformed the world. A member of the 5th Vanguard of Dawn, she also fought in the Second Great Mist War, leaving her mark through both her genius and her contribution to one of the greatest conflicts in Undevil's history.
members.thor.bio: Responsible for BISC8's technical architecture and project management. Combines technical expertise and leadership to guide the team in creating innovative games.
members.galetti.bio: A 2D artist and animator responsible for the visual identity of BISC8's games. Creates illustrations, sprites, and animations that define each project's unique style.
members.ian.bio: BISC8's C# programmer and web developer. Responsible for game programming and the development of the studio's website.
members.maria.bio: BISC8's narrative designer. Responsible for creating stories, dialogue, and world-building that connect players to the universes of the studio's games.
